program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g -1))
                  (sep-cols (for/list ((c (range 0 w)) #:when
                                (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r c) bg)))
                              c))
                  (sep-set (make-hash))
                  (dummy (for ((c sep-cols)) (hash-set! sep-set c #t)))
                  (regions (list))
                  (current (list))
                  (dummy2 (for ((c (range 0 w)))
                            (if (hash-has-key? sep-set c)
                                (begin
                                  (unless
                                    (null? current)
                                    (set! regions (append regions (list current))))
                                  (set! current (list)))
                                (set! current (append current (list c))))))
                  (dummy3 (unless
                            (null? current)
                            (set! regions (append regions (list current)))))
                  (region-colors (for/list ((reg regions))
                                   (let ((colors (make-hash)))
                                     (for ((c reg))
                                       (for ((r (range 0 h)))
                                         (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                           (when (!= v bg) (hash-set! colors v #t)))))
                                     (car (hash-keys colors)))))
                  (n (length regions))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for ((i (range 0 n)))
               (let ((reg (list-ref regions i))
                     (repl (list-ref region-colors (remainder (+ i 1) n))))
                 (for ((c reg))
                   (for ((r (range 0 h)))
                     (when (= (at g r c) bg) (hash-set! result (list r c) repl))))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
